verdict.rationale: An IaC product could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, such as AI explanations of plans or state, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no built-in AI-generated insights or suggestions. The Terraform MCP server only gives external AI models access to registry docs, modules, policies and workspaces. That makes it a building block for outside agents, not an in-product insights feature, so it earns no credit here.
